slides.title: AREA OF A TRIANGLE: DON'T FORGET THE ½
THE FORMULA
lines: Height is perpendicular to the base
slides.note: A triangle is half of a rectangle (or parallelogram) with the same base and height.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Find the area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: A right triangle has legs 5 and 12 and hypotenuse 13. Find its area.
steps: The legs are perpendicular, so use them as base and height

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Height is the perpendicular distance, not a slanted side.
In a right triangle, the legs are the base and height. Never use the hypotenuse.

pageTitle: Area of a Triangle: Formula and Examples
